paper_id: Data Dependency-Aware Code Generation from Enhanced UML Sequence Diagrams
title: Data Dependency-Aware Code Generation from Enhanced UML Sequence Diagrams
motivation: LLMs从自然语言生成代码时,隐式数据依赖难以正确推断,导致复杂服务架构代码生成失败
problem_framing: 将数据依赖推断作为独立任务,从UML时序图中显式构建数据依赖图后再合成代码
key_insight: 用数学形式化建模数据依赖问题,可利用LLM数学推理优势,分离控制流重建与依赖推断
method_signature: 增强时序图+数学形式化提示+可达性剪枝的DDI任务
evaluation_criteria: DDI用Prec/Rec/F1,代码生成用编译通过率和单元测试通过率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Action类型依赖F1仅71.11%,低于API的92.25%;QueryParentAccounts全测试通过率下降11%
evidence_for_taste: forces LLMs to simultaneously reconstruct control flow and infer implicit data dependencies
directly leverages LLMs inherent strength in mathematical reasoning
reducing hallucination probability and noise interference
thinking_moves: 从LLM认知负荷过载角度识别根本问题
将模糊的自然语言问题转化为严格数学问题
先构建可达性图剪枝冗余上下文再推理
模块化分解:先DDI再代码生成
